method: SHA-check every saved float32 row, independently sort all512 raw expert logits descending (tie smaller ID), compare ordered first10 with actual saved selected IDs. The513th raw logit is the shared gate and excluded.
selection_acceptance_rule: Exact ordered top10; finite logits/weights; unique integer IDs in[0,512); nonnegative selected weights. Sum error is descriptive, no new tolerance.
